QuestInfo.name: [Boss Battle] Pink Bean
QuestInfo.0:
Beyond the Temple of Time, at the end of Memory Lane, someone made the wrong wish at the Goddess altar. As a result, a monster from a different world has been summoned. Although it may look friendly, Pink Bean is an extremely dangerous monster! Defeat Pink Bean.




- #eParticipation Requirements#n: 


1) Normal Mode: Lv. 160 and up

2) Chaos Mode: Lv. 170 and up 


- #eParty Size#n: 3+

- #eRoute#n: 

1) Normal Mode: Temple of Time - Twilight of Gods

2) Chaos Mode: Temple of Time - Twilight of Gods
